title: Use Group VI – uses subject to open use allowances
previewText: For uses denoted with a “U” in Section 42-161 (Use Group VI – general use allowances), a use may be open or enclosed without restriction, except that for eating or drinking establishments, such open use shall be limited to outdoor table service.
